manual_name: Introduction To OpendTect and OpendTect Pro Training Manual 7.0
manual_reference: 1.4.2a 3D Auto-track, steps 2–18 (Seed Trace method; pre-load in step 1 is part of the initial state; Adjacent Parent workflow and parents-path editing pp.74–77 are out of scope)
goal: F3 Demo에서 Random Line에 표시된 4 Dip steered median filter 위에 3D auto-track(Section Auto-track, Seed Trace 방식, Event type Peak, Correlation 사용 60%)으로 새 3D Horizon 패치를 추적하고, QC 후 그 패치를 Lock 한다. 매뉴얼 §1.4.2a.

initial_state.description: F3 Demo survey 활성. 4 Dip steered median filter가 Survey > Pre-Load > Seismic으로 pre-load 되어 있고, Random Line > Add Default Data로 서베이 중앙의 random line에 표시됨. 3D Horizon 트리 항목 비어 있음. Horizon Tracking Settings 창은 열려 있지 않음.
must_be_true: '4 Dip steered median filter' displayed on a Random Line
Horizon Tracking Settings window not open

_study2_note: Authored from the manual text only (2026-09-21), before any screenshot was captured. visual_state_gt is filled after capture by gt_enumerate_visible_elements.py + external review; patterns/keywords are NOT changed after the screenshots or any model output are seen.

steps.expected_action_text_pattern: (?i)\b(3D Horizon|Auto and Manual Tracking|Auto and Manual|New)\b

capture_instructions.screen_state: OpendTect main window. Random Line with '4 Dip steered median filter' displayed in the 3D scene (manual step 2). Tree: 3D Horizon item EMPTY. No Horizon Tracking Settings window. No context menu open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Right-clicked Random Line > Add Default Data and confirmed the seismic is displayed; nothing about horizons done yet.

allowed_alternatives.note: Confirming/selecting the Mode-tab settings (manual step 5) is also a valid next action when they are visible but not yet confirmed.

capture_instructions.screen_state: 'Horizon Tracking Settings - <New Horizon 1>' window open on the MODE tab: Section Auto-track selected, Method = Seed Trace. Tree shows <New Horizon 1>. Event tab NOT yet opened.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Right-clicked 3D Horizon > New > Auto and Manual Tracking (manual steps 3–5) and chosen Section Auto-track / Seed Trace.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Same window, EVENT tab active: Event type = Peak selected; Threshold type Relative difference, Allowed difference 25, Search window -8 8 at defaults. 'Picked on: 4 Dip steered median filter' visible. Correlation tab not yet opened.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked the Event tab and selected Peak (manual steps 6–7).

allowed_alternatives.note: Manual step 11 (Steering = No) is a valid intermediate action when a dip-steering licence is present.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Same window, CORRELATION tab active: Use Correlation = Yes, Correlation threshold (%) = 60.0, Compare window -40 40. No seed picked yet; the random line shows seismic only.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked the Correlation tab, set Use Correlation to Yes and the threshold to 60 (manual steps 8–10).
must_not_show: a seed point on the section

capture_instructions.screen_state: 3D scene with the random line; ONE seed picked on a Peak event (seed marker visible, cross cursor). <New Horizon 1> active (selected) in the tree. Horizon Tracking Settings window still open (its toolbar shows the Auto-Track and Retrack-All icons). No tracked patch yet.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked once on a Peak reflector on the random line to place a seed (manual step 13).
must_not_show: a tracked horizon patch beyond the seed

allowed_alternatives.note: Manual step 15b: v/V shortcut to show the horizon at sections only.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Auto-Track has run: a horizon patch is visible around the seed on the random line / in the 3D scene. <New Horizon 1> in the tree. Settings window still open. Patch NOT locked; no context menu open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Clicked the Auto-Track icon in the Horizon Tracking Settings window (manual step 14).

allowed_alternatives.note: Ground-truth element mention for the grounding validator.

capture_instructions.screen_state: GOAL-REACHED terminal state: the patch has been locked (right-click patch > Tracking > Lock, or Ctrl + right-click > Lock). Context menu closed. Patch visible; <New Horizon 1> in tree.
must_not_show: a new seed placed after locking

completion.note: step_6 depicts the goal-achieved terminal state (one auto-tracked horizon patch locked). Continuing with more seeds (manual steps 19–23) is out of scope.
